eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Age requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants aged ≥18 at the time of signing the ICF.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Wilson Disease diagnosis
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Diagnosis of WD by Leipzig Criteria ≥ 4 documented by testing as outlined in the 2012 European Association for the Study of Liver WD Clinical Practice Guidelines (Ferenci, 2003; EASL, 2012) or by historical test results for WD including some or all of the following: Presence of Kayser Fleischer rings, Neurological symptoms, Serum ceruloplasmin below reference range, Coombs-negative hemolytic anemia, Elevated liver or urinary copper, Presence of mutations in the ATP7B gene, or Other, as considered appropriate, may be used instead to confirm the diagnosis of WD.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Benefit from decoppering therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants who in the opinion of the referring Investigator may benefit from decoppering therapy.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to comply with all study-related procedures.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to reside in CRU
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to reside in the CRU for intensive metabolic monitoring of copper and molybdenum.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to discontinue chelator therapy
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to discontinue chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiation of ALXN1840 to allow a baseline assessment of copper balance.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Adequate venous access
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants with adequate venous access to allow collection of required blood samples.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Ability to swallow tablets
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants must be able to swallow intact ALXN1840 tablets.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to avoid copper/zinc/molybdenum minerals
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants willing to adhere to copper/molybdenum-controlled diet during inpatient periods and willing to comply with a low copper dietary requirement during the Outpatient Period.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Contraceptive use requirement
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Contraceptive use by men or women should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. a. Male participants: Male participants, if heterosexually active and with a female spouse or partner of childbearing potential or a pregnant or breastfeeding spouse or partner, must agree to use barrier contraception (male condom) for the duration of the study and for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Male participants must not donate sperm for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female spouses or partners of male participants who are of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception as defined in Section 10.4, starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before (the male participant's) first study intervention administration and continuing until at least 3 months after the end of their male partner's systemic exposure to the study intervention. Barrier contraception (male condom) is required even with documented medical assessment of surgical success of a vasectomy. For male participants who have had a vasectomy (with documented evidence of azoospermia if possible) and agree to use a male condom for the stated time period, no additional contraceptive method is required by their female partner. b. Female participants: Female participants or female partners of male participants of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding females), if heterosexually active, must be willing to follow protocol-specified contraception guidance starting at least 1 menstrual cycle before first study intervention administration and continuing for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants must not donate ova for at least 3 months after the end of systemic exposure of the study intervention. Female participants who are documented as being of non-childbearing potential as defined in Section 10.4 are exempt from contraception requirements. Highly effective contraceptive methods for female participants and female partners of male participants are described in Section 10.4.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Informed consent capability
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants capable of giving signed informed consent, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Decompensated cirrhosis or MELD score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Decompensated cirrhosis or model for end-stage liver disease (MELD) score > 13.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Modified Nazer score
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Modified Nazer score > 7 (Dhawan, 2005).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Clinically significant gastrointestinal bleed within past 3 months.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: ALT elevation
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) > 2 × upper limit of normal (ULN).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Marked neurological disease
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Marked neurological disease requiring assistance with self-care or activities of daily life.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Low hemoglobin
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Hemoglobin less than lower limit of the reference range for age and sex.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Active infection with hepatitis B virus (positive hepatitis B surface antigen) or C virus (participants with positive hepatitis C antibody result would require confirmation of active disease with a positive hepatitis C polymerase chain reaction test), or seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Significant medical history or current disorder
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History or presence of/significant history of or current cardiovascular, respiratory, hepatic, renal, gastrointestinal, endocrinological, hematological, or neurological disorders, or psychiatric disorder that in the opinion of the Investigator may constitute a risk when taking the study intervention; or may interfere with the interpretation of data.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate within 1 year prior to dosing.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Previous treatment with zinc
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Experimental or unapproved therapy use
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: The use of an experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy at the same time or within 90 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, prior to the Screening Visit.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Renal failure
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants in renal failure, defined as in end-stage renal disease on dialysis (chronic kidney disease [CKD] stage 5) or creatinine clearance < 30 mL/min (Levey, 2006).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Pregnant (or females who are planning to become pregnant) or breastfeeding females (women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test result at screening).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Known sensitivity to ALXN1840, ALXN1840 excipients (anhydrous dicalcium phosphate, anhydrous sodium carbonate), or any of the ingredients contained in ALXN1840 or related compounds.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Likely non-compliance
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: In the opinion of the Investigator, the participant and/or their legal guardian is likely to be non-compliant or uncooperative during the study.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: History of illicit drug abuse, history of significant alcohol abuse within 1 year prior to the Screening Visit, or clinical evidence of substance and/or alcohol abuse within the 2 years before screening. Alcohol abuse is defined as regular weekly intake of more than 14 units (for both males and females), using the following National Health Service (NHS) alcohol tracker http://www.nhs.uk/Tools/Pages/drinks-tracker.aspx.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Positive urine drug toxicology screen
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids will not be tested).

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Alcohol consumption within 48 hours prior to study intervention administration or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day -8.

eligibilityCriterionItems.name: Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu
eligibilityCriterionItems.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study.

medicalDevices.name: Intravenous Cannula
medicalDevices.label: IV Cannula
medicalDevices.description: Peripheral venous cannula placed to minimize needle sticks for repeated blood draws; must not be left in place longer than 72 hours and must be flushed minimum every 8 hours

medicalDevices.name: Automated Blood Pressure Device
medicalDevices.label: Automated BP Monitor
medicalDevices.description: Completely automated device used for blood pressure and heart rate measurements; manual techniques used only if automated device is not available

medicalDevices.name: 12-Lead ECG Machine
medicalDevices.label: ECG Device
medicalDevices.description: Device used to perform triplicate 12-lead electrocardiograms for assessment of heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, and QTcF intervals; ECG printed at time of collection for review

medicalDevices.name: Large Water Bottle Dispenser
medicalDevices.label: Water Dispenser
medicalDevices.description: Shared large water bottle dispenser from which all participants drink during inpatient periods; water samples collected and analyzed for copper and molybdenum content

arms.name: ALXN1840 Treatment
arms.description: All participants receive ALXN1840 with dose titration starting at 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days, followed by titration up to 30 mg/day on Day 29. Single-arm, open-label, repeat-dose study.

objectives.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
objectives.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat-dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

endpoints.name: Primary Copper Balance Endpoint
endpoints.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Objective
objectives.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Change in Copper Balance Endpoint
endpoints.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint - Clinical Laboratory Assessments
endpoints.text: Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis)

objectives.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Objective
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Endpoint
endpoints.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Objective
objectives.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Endpoint
endpoints.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint - ECG
endpoints.text: Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12-lead ECG

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Objective
objectives.text: Assess steady-state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Endpoint
endpoints.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint - Vital Signs
endpoints.text: Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

objectives.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Objective
objectives.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Endpoint
endpoints.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

objectives.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
objectives.text: Determine the steady-state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Secondary PK Parameters Endpoint
endpoints.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF-molybdenum

objectives.name: Safety and Tolerability Objective
objectives.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated-dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Safety Endpoint - TEAEs and SAEs
endpoints.text: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs)

objectives.name: Exploratory Dose Response Objective
objectives.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Dose Response Endpoint
endpoints.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Objective
objectives.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Endpoint
endpoints.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

objectives.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Objective
objectives.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

endpoints.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and LBC Endpoint
endpoints.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

estimands.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 15mg/day
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who meet eligibility criteria and are enrolled in the inpatient study periods (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of mean daily copper balance (mean, standard deviation, median, range) for each collection period.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 15 mg/day due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 15mg/day)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the 15 mg/day collection periods

intercurrentEvents.name: Outpatient period extension (Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 15mg/day)
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient period (Day 9 to Day 23) is extended up to an additional 14 days per adaptive protocol feature, potentially affecting timing of steady-state assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete dietary collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to complete full copper intake or output collection during an inpatient collection period, resulting in missing balance data

intercurrentEvents.name: Concomitant copper-chelating or zinc therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant uses prohibited concomitant copper-chelating agents or zinc therapy during the study that could confound copper balance measurements

estimands.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 30mg/day
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who have completed the 15 mg/day period and escalated to 30 mg/day ALXN1840 (All Participants Who Received 30 mg/day Dose (30 mg Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of mean daily copper balance (mean, standard deviation, median, range) for each collection period at 30 mg/day.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study due to safety concerns identified by the Investigator or Alexion, and does not receive 30 mg/day dose

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction from 30 mg/day due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption from ALXN1840 30 mg/day due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the 30 mg/day collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation during 30 mg/day period (Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 30mg/day)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the 30 mg/day collection periods (Days 31-39)

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete dietary collection at 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to complete full copper intake or output collection during the 30 mg/day inpatient collection period

estimands.name: Secondary Change in Copper Balance Estimand - 15 mg/day vs Baseline
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study with evaluable pretreatment baseline copper balance data (All Enrolled Participants with Baseline and Post-baseline Copper Balance Data) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in mean daily copper balance; paired difference (post-baseline minus baseline) with mean and 95% confidence interval.

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete baseline collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not complete the full 4-day pretreatment baseline collection period (Days -4 through -1), resulting in missing or partial baseline copper balance data

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during 15 mg/day period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 15 mg/day before completion of the post-baseline collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before post-baseline assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the 15 mg/day post-baseline collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Zinc therapy washout incomplete
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has not been off zinc therapy for the required minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1, potentially confounding baseline copper balance measurements

estimands.name: Secondary Change in Copper Balance Estimand - 30 mg/day vs Baseline
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who escalated to 30 mg/day and have evaluable pretreatment baseline copper balance data (All Participants Who Received 30 mg/day with Baseline and Post-baseline Copper Balance Data) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in mean daily copper balance; paired difference (post-baseline minus baseline) with mean and 95% confidence interval.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day (Secondary Change in Copper Balance Estimand - 30 mg/day vs Baseline)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study and does not receive 30 mg/day, precluding 30 mg/day change from baseline assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction from 30 mg/day
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption from 30 mg/day before completion of the 30 mg/day collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation during 30 mg/day period (Secondary Change in Copper Balance Estimand - 30 mg/day vs Baseline)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the 30 mg/day collection periods

estimands.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Copper Disposition Data) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) for copper concentrations and quantities in each compartment by dose and collection period.

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete sample collection for copper disposition
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to provide complete food, drink, feces, urine, or blood samples required for copper disposition assessment during a collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 before completion of a copper disposition collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation (Secondary Copper Disposition Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all copper disposition collection periods

estimands.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who have reached ALXN1840 steady state (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Molybdenum Disposition Data at Steady State) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics (mean, standard deviation, median, minimum, maximum) for molybdenum concentrations and quantities in each compartment at steady state by dose.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to achieve steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not achieve ALXN1840 steady state as defined by the protocol before the molybdenum disposition collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete molybdenum sample collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to provide complete food, drink, feces, urine, or blood samples required for molybdenum disposition assessment at steady state

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption affecting steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 before or during the steady-state molybdenum disposition collection period

estimands.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who have reached ALXN1840 steady state (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Molybdenum Balance Data at Steady State) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of mean daily molybdenum balance (mean, standard deviation, median, range) at steady state for each dose; assessment of whether molybdenum balance equals zero (neutral balance) at steady state.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to achieve molybdenum steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not achieve ALXN1840 steady state as defined by the protocol, such that molybdenum(out) does not equal molybdenum(in)

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete molybdenum balance collection
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to complete full molybdenum intake or output collection during the steady-state collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption during steady-state period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 during the steady-state molybdenum balance collection period

estimands.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study receiving ALXN1840 (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Molybdenum Balance Data Across Collection Periods) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of cumulative molybdenum balance over time; assessment of net positive molybdenum balance as indicator of accumulation across collection periods by dose.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption affecting accumulation assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 during the accumulation assessment period, potentially confounding molybdenum accumulation estimates

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before accumulation assessment complete
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all collection periods required to assess molybdenum accumulation

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete molybdenum collection across periods
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant fails to provide complete molybdenum intake or output data across one or more collection periods required for accumulation assessment

estimands.name: Secondary PK Parameters Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who have received ALXN1840 and have evaluable PK samples (PK Analysis Population (all participants with at least one evaluable PK sample)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of PK parameters including AUC, Cmax, Cmin, Tmax, and half-life for plasma total molybdenum and PUF-molybdenum by dose level.

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing PK samples
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has missing or non-evaluable PK blood samples at one or more scheduled PK timepoints

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption affecting PK steady state
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 before or during the PK steady-state assessment period

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day for PK assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study and does not receive 30 mg/day, precluding 30 mg/day PK parameter estimation

estimands.name: Safety Estimand - TEAEs and SAEs
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who received at least one dose of ALXN1840 (Safety Population (all participants who received at least one dose of ALXN1840)) Summary measure: Frequency and percentage of participants with TEAEs and SAEs; incidence rates by system organ class and preferred term; severity grading and relationship to study treatment.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues ALXN1840 treatment due to a TEAE or SAE before completing the study

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to adverse event
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 due to a TEAE meeting dose modification criteria

intercurrentEvents.name: Concomitant medication use for adverse event management
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant uses concomitant medications to manage TEAEs that may confound safety assessments

estimands.name: Safety Estimand - Clinical Laboratory Assessments
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who received at least one dose of ALXN1840 and have at least one post-baseline laboratory assessment (Safety Population) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of laboratory values at each timepoint; frequency and percentage of participants with clinically significant abnormalities; shift tables from baseline to post-baseline.

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing laboratory assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has missing or non-evaluable laboratory samples at one or more scheduled assessment timepoints

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before all laboratory assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all scheduled laboratory assessments

estimands.name: Safety Estimand - Physical Examinations
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who received at least one dose of ALXN1840 and have at least one post-baseline physical examination (Safety Population) Summary measure: Frequency and percentage of participants with clinically significant physical examination findings; descriptive summary of abnormal findings by body system.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before all physical examinations
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all scheduled physical examinations

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing physical examination
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant misses a scheduled physical examination assessment

estimands.name: Safety Estimand - ECG
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who received at least one dose of ALXN1840 and have at least one post-baseline ECG assessment (Safety Population) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of ECG parameters at each timepoint; frequency and percentage of participants with clinically significant ECG findings; shift tables from baseline.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before all ECG assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all scheduled ECG assessments

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing or non-evaluable ECG
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has a missing or technically non-evaluable triplicate 12-lead ECG at a scheduled timepoint

estimands.name: Safety Estimand - Vital Signs
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease who received at least one dose of ALXN1840 and have at least one post-baseline vital signs assessment (Safety Population) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of vital sign values at each timepoint; frequency and percentage of participants with clinically significant vital sign abnormalities; change from baseline.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before all vital sign assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all scheduled vital sign assessments

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing vital sign assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant misses a scheduled vital sign assessment

estimands.name: Exploratory Dose Response Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study with evaluable copper balance data at both 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day dose levels (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Copper Balance Data at Both Dose Levels) Summary measure: Descriptive comparison of mean daily copper balance between 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day dose levels; graphical and tabular presentation of dose-response relationship.

intercurrentEvents.name: Failure to escalate to 30 mg/day (Exploratory Dose Response Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for the duration of the study and does not receive 30 mg/day, precluding intra-patient dose comparison

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction during collection period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption during a copper balance collection period, confounding dose-response assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Incomplete copper balance data at one dose level
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has incomplete copper balance data at one of the two dose levels, precluding full dose-response comparison

estimands.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study with evaluable copper balance data across multiple collection periods (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Copper Balance Data Across Multiple Collection Periods) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of mean daily copper balance at each collection period over time; graphical presentation of copper balance trajectory from baseline through Day 39.

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before completing all time points
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all collection periods required to assess treatment duration effects on copper balance

intercurrentEvents.name: Outpatient period extension (Exploratory Treatment Duration Estimand)
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient period is extended up to 14 additional days per adaptive protocol feature, altering the timing of subsequent collection periods and potentially affecting treatment duration assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption affecting time course
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 during the study, potentially confounding the assessment of treatment duration effects on copper balance

estimands.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and LBC Estimand
estimands.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study with evaluable ceruloplasmin and LBC data (All Enrolled Participants with Evaluable Ceruloplasmin and LBC Data) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC values at each timepoint; change from predose at each assessment day.

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing ceruloplasmin or LBC samples
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant has missing or non-evaluable ceruloplasmin or LBC blood samples at one or more scheduled assessment timepoints

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before all ceruloplasmin assessments
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing all scheduled ceruloplasmin and LBC assessments through Day 39

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption affecting ceruloplasmin trajectory
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 before a scheduled ceruloplasmin or LBC assessment, potentially confounding the interpretation of treatment effects

eligibilityCriteria.name: Ability to comply with study procedures
Willingness to adhere to controlled diet
Active viral infection or HIV seropositivity
Significant medical history or current disorder
Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or tetrathiomolybdate
History of illicit drug or significant alcohol abuse
Alcohol consumption or positive alcohol breath test
Unwillingness to complete every meal and tolerate controlled menu

notes.text: Abbreviations: ALT = alanine aminotransferase; AST = aspartate aminotransferase; IB = Investigator's Brochure; PK = pharmacokinetics; WD = Wilson disease.
Abbreviations: CRF = case report form; CRU = clinical research unit; EOS = End of Study; SoA = Schedule of Activities.
Addition of text to the footnote to state that procedures specific to screening sites (only in the US) detailed in Section 8. As per Section 8 (below).

Number of days changed from 30 days to 21 days in the following sentence: the inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 30→21 days after discontinuation of zinc. Rationale: To align the number of days with the mention of zinc discontinuation elsewhere in the protocol.

Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures. Rationale: To facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US and to lessen inconvenience for participants without compromising the quality of the study.

This amendment is considered to be substantial based on the criteria set forth in Article 10(a) of Directive 2001/20/EC of the European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, the US Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) regulation at 21 CFR part 312.30(b), and any applicable local regulations.
Samples collected within ± 10% or 30 min, whichever is less, of the scheduled time will not be considered a protocol deviation.

Excess/additional samples may be stored for up to 5 years and used for PD and/or diagnostic biomarker development and research to understand the pathways associated with the mechanism of action of ALXN1840. These samples will not be used for genetic analyses (ie, RNA or DNA analyses).

A single biobanked serum sample will be collected predose from each participant to serve as a retained sample during the study. Samples will remain on site and will be discarded following the completion of the clinical study report. The sample will not be used for genetic testing.
A cannula may be placed to minimize needle sticks; however, a catheter may not be left in place for longer than 72 hours and should be flushed a minimum of every 8 hours.
Medical Monitor Name and Contact Information can be found in the Study Contact List.

Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period.
At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

Individuals who do not meet the criteria for participation in this study (screen failure) due to a reason that is expected to resolve or has resolved may be rescreened based on discussion and agreement between the Investigator and the Medical Monitor. Rescreened participants are not required to reconsent as long as they have signed the latest version of the ICF.

If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed. This review of the ECG printed at the time of collection must be documented.

Investigators are not obligated to actively seek AE or SAE data after conclusion of the study participation. However, if the Investigator learns of any SAE, including a death, at any time after a participant has been discharged from the study, and he/she considers the event to be reasonably related to the study intervention or study participation, the Investigator must promptly notify Alexion.

This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol.
As this study is an exploratory study, no formal hypothesis testing is being conducted. Study results will be summarized using descriptive statistics.

During the inpatient collection periods, daily urine will be pooled (24_hour collection) with volumes recorded for each 24_hour period; participants will be strongly encouraged to void within 2 hours of completion of each 24_hour period (ie, dosing time).
During the Outpatient Period, participants will use SMS text messaging to confirm study intervention administration.

studyInterventions.name: ALXN1840
studyInterventions.description: bis-choline tetrathiomolybdate (formerly WTX101), a novel copper binding agent for the treatment of Wilson disease. Administered as open-label, repeat-dose, single-arm study starting at 15 mg/day for approximately 28 days then titrated to 30 mg/day.

studyInterventions.name: Paracetamol/acetaminophen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted for use as an exception with Investigator approval at a maximum dose of 1000 mg per day.

studyInterventions.name: Ibuprofen
studyInterventions.description: Permitted with caution as a CYP2C9 substrate; must not exceed 1200 mg in any 24-hour period and may only be used with Investigator approval.

studyInterventions.name: Penicillamine
studyInterventions.description: Copper-chelating therapy (standard of care for Wilson disease). Must be discontinued starting on Day -4 to allow baseline assessment of copper/molybdenum balance prior to ALXN1840 treatment.

studyInterventions.name: Trientine
studyInterventions.description: Copper-chelating therapy (standard of care for Wilson disease). Must be discontinued starting on Day -4 to allow baseline assessment of copper/molybdenum balance prior to ALXN1840 treatment.

studyInterventions.name: Zinc therapy
studyInterventions.description: Standard of care therapy for Wilson disease. Must be discontinued at least 21 days prior to Day 1 (zinc discontinuation occurs at Day -21 per Schedule of Activities) due to its effect on metallothionein upregulation and fecal copper excretion.

studyInterventions.name: Tetrathiomolybdate (other forms)
studyInterventions.description: Previous treatment with ALXN1840 or other form of tetrathiomolybdate is prohibited within 1 year prior to dosing (exclusion criterion).

studyInterventions.name: Experimental or unapproved/unlicensed therapy
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited within 90 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to Screening Visit.

studyInterventions.name: Prescription medications (general)
studyInterventions.description: Participants must abstain from prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) of Day -7, except as described in allowed medications section.

studyInterventions.name: Nonprescription/over-the-counter medications (general)
studyInterventions.description: Must be abstained from within 7 days or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) before Day -7 until follow-up visit completion, except as permitted. May be taken under direction of Investigator if not expected to impact study outcomes.

studyInterventions.name: Herbal remedies/dietary supplements
studyInterventions.description: Must be discontinued at least 7 days prior to first admission until study completion.

studyInterventions.name: St John's Wort
studyInterventions.description: Prohibited from 2 weeks before the planned first study intervention administration until after EOS Visit.

studyInterventions.name: Minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum
studyInterventions.description: Participants must avoid use of minerals containing copper, zinc, or molybdenum throughout the study duration.

studyInterventions.name: CYP2C9 and CYP2B6 substrate drugs
studyInterventions.description: Investigators should use caution in co-administration of drugs known to be substrates of CYP2C9 and CYP2B6, as per ALXN1840 Investigator's Brochure.

studyInterventions.name: Copper/molybdenum-controlled diet
studyInterventions.description: Standardized copper- and molybdenum-controlled meals provided during inpatient periods. Initiated after registration/inclusion (Day -7) and maintained throughout Inpatient Period 1 (Day -8 to Day 9) and Inpatient Period 2 (Day 23 to Day 40). Participants encouraged to adhere to copper-controlled diet during outpatient period.
